resources.string: An offline Pinyin keyboard. The first characters for each syllable never move, so you can type without looking.
1. Turn on Mini Pinyin in the system keyboard list
Ready. Mini Pinyin is your current keyboard.
Works fully offline. Learned words, emoji counts and the last five clipboard texts stay on this device. You can export the word list yourself.
GPL-3.0. Dictionary: rime-ice (GPL-3.0). Traditional Chinese tables: OpenCC (Apache-2.0). English word frequency: AOSP LatinIME (Apache-2.0). Next-word counts: Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0).
